title: Perihelion video support, hover previews, and UI alignment
content:
Perihelion has completed a major media and interface update adding full video identification and playback, refined toolbar organization, and share workflow fixes.

Key highlights:

  • Video Previews & VID Badges: Video files (.mp4, .webm, .mov, .m4v, .ogv) now display distinct yellow VID badges on gallery and staging cards, with smooth muted hover-to-play video previews in the browsing grid.
  • Lightbox Video Player & Darker Backdrop: Lightbox now renders an interactive video player with standard controls (no autoplay on modal open). The backdrop for videos is tuned ~25% darker (bg-[#484d4a]/94 / bg-[#040504]/96) with a smooth 200ms transition.
  • Toolbar Layout & Blue Active States: Added an INCLUDE VIDEO toggle on Line 1 next to other file filters and moved Share Code to Line 3 beside tags and lists. Filter options (MAX MODE, INCLUDE OTHER FILES, INCLUDE VIDEO) now highlight in bold blue when active.
  • Staging & Share Creation Unblocked: Made note title entry optional during staging share creation with automatic fallback generation, resolving a button state lock and enabling immediate share link creation.
  • Typography & Options Polish: Aligned the IMAGES / FILES section heading to match OPTIONS in tracking and weight, cleaned up the Options page layout, and fixed staging dark mode styling.
